verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Next.js itself accepting or interpreting natural-language commands. The built-in MCP endpoint exposes the running app to external coding agents, and llms.txt serves docs to LLMs; the natural-language layer in both cases belongs to the outside agent, so these are adjacent building blocks rather than the capability itself. The community report that Claude Code works well with Next.js describes a third-party tool and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
